column1: # defaults/worker-rules.tsv - who reads which part of the instruction surface.
# Owner: bin/jg-worker-rules.sh. One row per part: <part><TAB><roles>.
# A part is a section of AGENTS.md or a group of skills; the file that supplies it stays
# the only source of its text. Roles: overwatch squad_lead builder reviewer scout, or all.
# `check` refuses a section or skill that no row names, or that two rows name.
# A `keep:<names>` row names personal skills the brief scaffold names, outside this repository's own surface: it only feeds
# bin/jg-launch-settings.sh's keep-list, and `check` and `measure` do not read it.
